patch_state: Dirty working tree preserved; readiness changes are layered on the existing scoring and lifecycle work.
executive_assessment: Local AI Lab now has a trustworthy evidence lifecycle instead of a generic draft backlog. Owner review produced 23 confirmed real runs across nine models. Two genuine Qwen judge disagreements remain for human disposition, one repaired Gemma draft awaits a compatible independent reviewer, ten invalid or retired generative runs are quarantined with recorded remediation, the BGE embedding artifact is routed outside the LLM rubric, and no run remains ambiguously unscored. Rejected evidence stays available for audit but cannot return to rankings or confirmation. A refreshed portfolio report separates benchmark authority from install decisions, names confirmed workload leaders, explains every efficiency exclusion, and passed automated privacy scanning. Full validation passes. The product is still No-Go because the 92-point threshold, human keyboard audit, interrupted-capture recovery proof, retrieval-model evaluation, seven missing portfolio decisions, and historical run metadata gaps remain open.

evidence_register.title: Repository baseline
evidence_register.finding: Revision d345266 was evaluated with the pre-existing dirty scoring/lifecycle patch preserved; no unrelated work was discarded.

evidence_register.title: All dashboard records
evidence_register.finding: The SQLite database contains 16 models, 41 runs, 29 active score rows, 27 confirmed scores, 2 imported drafts, and 12 run rows without an active score; these totals include four demo fixtures.

evidence_register.title: Real evidence subset
evidence_register.finding: Excluding demo rows leaves 12 models and 37 runs: 23 confirmed runs across nine models, three valid draft or review-pending runs, ten rejected or quarantined generative runs, one non-generative embedding run, and zero ambiguous unscored runs.

evidence_register.title: Confirmed recommendation coverage
evidence_register.finding: Confirmed evidence now covers nine real models: Qwen3.6 35B A3B, Qwen3.6 27B Obliteratus, Dolphin Mistral 24B Venice, Qwen3 Coder 30B A3B, llama3.3 70B, qwen2.5 32B, qwen2.5 14B, qwen2.5 7B, and Qwen2.5 VL 7B.

evidence_register.title: Local services
evidence_register.finding: LM Studio served a loopback /v1/models inventory and Qdrant served a healthy dimension-checked collection during the audit; Docker Compose infrastructure was not started by this loop.

evidence_register.title: Candidate behavior repairs
evidence_register.finding: Focused tests prove non-generative role exclusion, review-before-confirmation, artifact-level confirmation, bounded invalid-output retry, and truthful per-stage queue status.

evidence_register.title: Live local RAG journey
evidence_register.finding: Doctor verified the exact LM Studio model and 1024-dimensional Qdrant collection; sample ingest produced two chunks and Qwen Coder returned a local answer with two citations.

evidence_register.title: Live artifact confirmation route
evidence_register.finding: A real draft artifact detail route returned HTTP 200 with the Score Confirmation panel and Confirm Draft Score control after independent review.

evidence_register.title: Live independent review recovery
evidence_register.finding: The dashboard independently reviewed 21 of 26 untouched imported generative drafts on the first pass, preserved five failures as pending, and completed all five on a bounded retry without rerunning benchmark captures; all 27 current drafts now have review records.

evidence_register.title: Sanitized report export
evidence_register.finding: A freshly generated report contained no user home paths, bearer tokens, API-key assignments, serialized raw prompt/response payloads, or the known RAG smoke prompt.

evidence_register.title: Live cockpit readiness
evidence_register.finding: Home and Lab both returned HTTP 200 with primary judge, independent reviewer, Qdrant, LM Studio CLI, and Ollama CLI ready; the shared inventory was cached and the second Home request completed in approximately 12 ms.

evidence_register.title: Five-minute fixture path
evidence_register.finding: The documented offline path synchronized dependencies, initialized a disposable fixture database, and generated a nonempty fixture report without Docker or a model server.

evidence_register.title: All-zero agreement quarantine
evidence_register.finding: All-zero, malformed, capture-error, human-rejected, and role-mismatched artifacts are now removed from active rankings and human confirmation while their raw files and prior score attempts remain available for audit.

evidence_register.title: Owner disposition sheet
evidence_register.finding: Owner disposition and automatic triage reduced the live queue to two valid Qwen judge disagreements and one Gemma draft awaiting a compatible independent reviewer; ten invalid or retired generative runs have explicit quarantine actions and BGE is outside the LLM lane.

evidence_register.title: Judge contract hardening
evidence_register.finding: The local judge prompt now uses nonnumeric type placeholders instead of a zero-filled example; the harness retries invalid totals and labels, recomputes total_score from the eleven validated metrics, preserves judge_reported_total only for provenance, and warns on zero vectors or total mismatch.

evidence_register.title: Live runtime baseline
evidence_register.finding: Ten warmed requests per major dashboard route completed with medians from 1.8 to 26.2 ms and maxima below 28 ms; the idle server used 26.3 MiB RSS and 0% CPU. Runs produced 305.3 KiB of HTML, making progressive disclosure the priority over a backend rewrite.

evidence_register.title: Automated evidence reconciliation
evidence_register.finding: Automatic triage preserved raw artifacts and prior judge attempts while removing invalid imported drafts. Runs now reports 23 confirmed, 3 valid draft or review-pending, 10 quarantined, 1 non-generative, and 0 ambiguously unscored real runs.

evidence_register.title: Responsive route matrix
evidence_register.finding: All ten required routes were inspected at 1440x900, 1024x768, and 390x844 with no page-level horizontal overflow. Dense charts and tables remain in deliberate contained scroll regions; human keyboard traversal is still pending.

evidence_register.title: Portfolio report comprehension
evidence_register.finding: The first independent review failed because efficiency exclusions were absent. After revision, a fresh independent reviewer correctly identified all confirmed workload leaders, incomplete decisions, exclusion counts, next actions, and no private path, prompt, response, token, credential, or secret.

risks.title: Portfolio decision authority is incomplete
risks.impact: Confirmed benchmark evidence covers nine models, but seven still lack an explicit keep, watch, retest, or remove decision and three valid drafts remain open.
risks.mitigation: Resolve the two genuine judge disagreements, obtain a compatible independent Gemma review, and record decisions for the seven confirmed models that still lack one.

risks.title: Resource evidence is incomplete
risks.impact: Seven confirmed real runs cannot support a tokens/sec versus RAM efficiency decision.
risks.mitigation: Use rerun-missing-evidence to capture both throughput and peak RAM; keep incomplete runs excluded from the frontier.

risks.title: Retrieval models lack actionable quality evidence
risks.impact: Embedding models are now safely excluded from LLM scoring but cannot yet be compared for RAG quality.
risks.mitigation: Add a small retrieval benchmark with recall, MRR or nDCG, latency, index size, and language coverage.

risks.title: Live recovery is not fully demonstrated
risks.impact: Automated tests cover lifecycle cleanup, but an interrupted real batch has not been resumed and completed in this audit.
risks.mitigation: Run one controlled interruption, verify cleanup, then retry without duplicate records.

risks.title: Viewport and accessibility evidence is incomplete
risks.impact: The responsive route matrix passed automated overflow inspection, but keyboard traversal and focus behavior still lack reliable human evidence.
risks.mitigation: Complete the keyboard and focus sections of reports/readiness/2026-07-18/human-verification-checklist.md and log every failure with severity and exit evidence.

risks.title: Dense data views remain costly on small screens
risks.impact: Horizontal tables and long identifiers can obscure the next action on mobile.
risks.mitigation: Move secondary columns into row details and retain a stable action/status summary at narrow widths.
